title: docs(desktop): drop stale completion-callback rule from card-stack design
claim: apps/desktop/DESIGN.md 'No completion callback may clear the measurement of a newly arrived card.' is stale because onExitComplete was removed.

evidence.source: The sentence is a prohibition, not a description, and main satisfies it: CardStack (apps/desktop/src/components/ui/card-stack.tsx:58-105) uses <AnimatePresence initial={false}> with no completion callback and retires the footprint by a min-height transition. The rule and the callback removal were committed together by the same author (140d12545a adds the DESIGN.md sentence; 4bcde77e53 removes onExitComplete's setHeight(0); same author, same timestamp), so the sentence records why the callback was removed. Deleting it would drop a live design constraint.
